lines.text: O LORD God of Hosts, who is like You?
O mighty LORD, Your faithfulness surrounds You.
when its waves mount up, You still them.
You crushed Rahab like a carcass;
You scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.
The heavens are Yours, and also the earth.
The earth and its fullness You founded.
Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at Your name.

pictures.scene: Vasily Surikov, Suvorov Crossing the Alps — the whole army going down the snow face of the mountain past the old general on the ridge, and awesome above all who surround Him, O LORD God of Hosts, who is like You
pictures.name: pd_surikov_ontzag

pictures.scene: Gustave Courbet, La Vague — the great wave standing up green and white out of the sea with the weight of the whole water behind it, O mighty LORD, Your faithfulness surrounds You, You rule the raging sea
pictures.name: pd_courbet_zee

pictures.scene: Nikolai Dubovskoi, Calm Before the Storm — the sea gone flat and silver under the heavy sky with not a thing moving on it, when its waves mount up, You still them, You crushed Rahab like a carcass
pictures.name: pd_dubovskoy_stilte

pictures.scene: Salvator Rosa, A Cavalry Battle — the riders breaking apart and scattering in the smoke with their standards going down, You scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm, the heavens are Yours, and also the earth
pictures.name: pd_rosa_verstrooid

pictures.scene: Ivan Shishkin, Oak Grove — the old oaks standing rooted in their own ground with the light coming down through them, the earth and its fullness You founded, north and south You created
pictures.name: pd_shishkin_aarde

pictures.scene: Ferdinand Hodler, Der Niesen — the one great mountain standing up out of the morning cloud with the snow bright along its ridge, Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at Your name, mighty is Your arm, strong is Your hand
pictures.name: pd_hodler_bergen
